video.title: AI欧腐《101次被弃：狼后不回头了/Rejected 101 Times：The Male Luna Will Never Turn Back》
video.desc:
经典渣攻穷追不舍剧本 以为换个名字我不认识你
I'm Elian. I loved my Alpha Cassius for ten years. In three years he threatened to reject me 101 times. The first hundred I knelt and begged him to stay, while the pack laughed. The 101st: he gave my mother's keepsake away and forced poison down my throat. That's when I knew he didn't care if I lived. This time, I won't kneel.
我叫 Elian。我爱了我的Alpha Cassius 十年。
三年里，他扬言要抛弃我，整整101次。前一百次，我跪下来求他留下，全族看着我笑。第101次：他把我母亲的遗物送了人，还强行把毒药灌进我喉咙。那一刻我才明白，我是死是活，他根本不在乎。
这一次，我不跪了。
